title: MCCH information acquisition by the UE

entities.name: MCCH information acquisition
entities.description: Procedure performed by an MBS capable UE to acquire MBS broadcast configuration information from MCCH.

entities.name: MCCH information change notification
entities.description: Trigger condition when the UE receives an MCCH information change notification.

entities.name: UE enters a cell broadcasting SIB20
entities.description: Trigger condition when the UE enters a cell that broadcasts SIB20.

entities.name: MBSBroadcastConfiguration message
entities.description: Message containing MBS broadcast configuration information transmitted on MCCH.

entities.name: MCCH
entities.description: Multicast Control Channel used for transmitting MBS broadcast configuration information.

entities.name: MBS capable UE
entities.description: UE that supports MBS broadcast services and is interested in or receiving such services.

relations.description: MCCH information acquisition procedure is triggered by MCCH information change notification.
MCCH information acquisition procedure is triggered when UE enters a cell broadcasting SIB20.
MCCH information acquisition procedure involves acquiring the MBSBroadcastConfiguration message.
MBSBroadcastConfiguration message is transmitted on MCCH.
MCCH information acquisition procedure is performed by MBS capable UEs.
